originalAlarm.description: The value written to `&pid_output` is never used.

presenceCondition: (and (= MARLIN_H true) (= PIDTEMP false) (= PID_DEBUG true))
model:
(define-fun PID_DEBUG () Bool
  true)
(define-fun MARLIN_H () Bool
  true)
(define-fun PIDTEMP () Bool
  false)
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: Same file as PRODUCT_54/89/104/105/119/134/186 (8c4377dd635.c, Marlin manage_heater). Dead store on 'pid_output' at line 13. When PIDTEMP=false, the '#ifdef PIDTEMP && #ifdef PID_DEBUG' block (containing the SERIAL_ECHO_START call — the known vbdb UndeclaredIdentifier bug when MARLIN_H=true) is NOT compiled. pid_output is set to 1 (line 11) then reassigned to 0 in the else branch (line 19) but never used — simplification artifact (real Marlin code uses pid_output to drive heating elements). The known bug (SERIAL_ECHO_START undefined when MARLIN_H=true) is not triggered because PIDTEMP=false.
